d: The Orange County Choppers crew takes on a build that means more than just creating another custom motorcycle. In partnership with the Make-A-Wish Foundation, Paul Sr., Paul Jr., and Mikey welcome inspirational Wish kids into the garage to help design their dream chopper. From star-shaped fabrication details inspired by the foundation's logo to hands-on experiences in the shop, this American Chopper episode brings a heartfelt purpose to motorcycle building. Watch as the crew turns the children's ideas into a custom motorcycle build filled with hope, creativity, and compassion. Watch…
